entry.title: EMM and MDM Systems Explained
entry.content:
EMM (Enterprise Mobility Management) and MDM (Mobile Device Management) are the core technology systems enterprises use to securely manage mobile devices, applications, and data. Here’s a systematic explanation covering their definitions, features, evolution, and use cases:

📱 1. Core concepts
MDM (Mobile Device Management)

Definition: Focused on the full lifecycle management of mobile devices (such as phones and tablets), including enrollment, configuration, monitoring, remote control (such as lock/wipe), and retirement146.

Use cases: Suited to devices issued uniformly by the company (such as logistics handheld terminals or corporate phones), where the hardware and OS need to be fully controlled39.

EMM (Enterprise Mobility Management)

Definition: An extension of MDM — a comprehensive solution that, beyond device management, also includes Mobile Application Management (MAM), Mobile Content Management (MCM), Mobile Identity Management (MIM), and other components. Its goal is to improve mobile productivity while guaranteeing security189.

Core capabilities: Supports BYOD (bring your own device), isolating corporate data from personal data through “containerization” technology, enabling fine-grained control (such as wiping only the data of corporate apps)59.

⚙️ 2. Core functional components
EMM works through the following modules:

MDM: device enrollment, policy configuration (password complexity, encryption), remote wipe16.

MAM (Mobile Application Management):

Enterprise app store distribution, silent install/update;

Control over app permissions (such as blocking screenshots/pasting)19.

MCM (Mobile Content Management):

Secure distribution of corporate files (such as contracts and reports);

Encrypted data storage, restricting sharing to unauthorized apps18.

MIM (Mobile Identity Management):

Single sign-on (SSO), multi-factor authentication;

Dynamically adjusting access permissions based on role/device state18.

📊 3. Differences between MDM and EMM
Dimension MDM EMM
Managed object Device hardware and OS Device + apps + data + identity
Control granularity Device level (full control) App/data level (e.g. managing only the corporate container)
Use cases Company-issued devices (COBO/COPE) Mainly BYOD (employee-owned devices)
Privacy compatibility Low (requires full control of the device) High (isolates corporate data, protects personal privacy)
Evolutionary relationship The base component of EMM An extension and upgrade of MDM
Example: In a BYOD scenario, EMM lets an employee access corporate email on a personal phone, but only encrypts and remotely wipes the data inside the corporate email app, without touching personal photos or other private content59.

⏳ 4. Technology evolution: from MDM to EMM
Mobile management technology has gone through three stages:

Device-driven stage (2007-2012): MDM dominated, with features limited to device enrollment, password policies, and remote wipe210.

Application management stage (2011-2013): MAM emerged, introducing sandboxes/containers to isolate corporate app data and meet BYOD needs25.

Content and identity convergence stage (2013-present):

EMM integrates MCM/MIM, enabling dynamic policies based on role, location, and device state (such as “block access to the finance system while traveling”)10;

Evolving toward UEM (Unified Endpoint Management), covering PCs, IoT devices, and more terminals35.

🏢 5. Business value for enterprises
Better security: Prevents data leaks (such as blocking corporate files from being saved to personal cloud drives) and defends against the risks of jailbroken/rooted devices16.

Better efficiency:

Automatic app distribution (such as installing a CRM tool across a sales team);

Remote troubleshooting, reducing on-site support costs9.

Compliance support: Meets regulatory requirements such as GDPR, with audit logs recording sensitive operations68.

💎 Summary
MDM is the starting point of mobile management, focused on device control; EMM is a more mature solution that, through fine-grained management of apps/data/identity, strikes a balance between security and employee experience. As remote work becomes widespread, EMM has become core infrastructure for enterprise mobility transformation and continues to evolve toward cross-device, intelligent UEM358.

entry.title: EMM与MDM系统详解
entry.content:
EMM（Enterprise Mobility Management，企业移动化管理）和MDM（Mobile Device Management，移动设备管理）是企业用于安全管理移动设备、应用及数据的核心技术体系。下面从定义、功能、演进和应用场景等方面进行系统说明：

📱 一、核心概念
MDM（移动设备管理）

定义：专注于移动设备（如手机、平板）的全生命周期管理，包括注册、配置、监控、远程控制（如锁定/擦除）及停用146。

适用场景：适用于企业统一配发的设备（如物流手持终端、公司手机），需完全控制硬件和操作系统39。

EMM（企业移动化管理）

定义：MDM的扩展，是一套综合解决方案，除设备管理外，还包含移动应用管理（MAM）、移动内容管理（MCM）、移动身份管理（MIM）等组件，目标是在保障安全的前提下提升移动办公效率189。

核心能力：支持BYOD（自带设备办公），通过“容器化”技术隔离企业数据与个人数据，实现细粒度控制（如仅擦除企业应用数据）59。

⚙️ 二、核心功能组件
EMM通过以下模块协同工作：

MDM：设备注册、策略配置（密码复杂度、加密）、远程擦除16。

MAM（移动应用管理）：

企业应用商店分发、静默安装/更新；

控制应用权限（如禁止截屏/粘贴）19。

MCM（移动内容管理）：

安全分发企业文件（如合同、报表）；

数据加密存储，限制分享至非授权应用18。

MIM（移动身份管理）：

单点登录（SSO）、多因素认证；

基于角色/设备状态动态调整访问权限18。

📊 三、MDM与EMM的区别
维度 MDM EMM
管理对象 设备硬件及操作系统 设备+应用+数据+身份
控制粒度 设备级（全盘控制） 应用/数据级（如仅管理企业容器）
适用场景 企业统一配发设备（COBO/COPE） BYOD（员工个人设备）为主
隐私兼容性 低（需完全控制设备） 高（隔离企业数据，保护个人隐私）
演进关系 EMM的基础组件 MDM的扩展与升级
示例：在BYOD场景中，EMM允许员工用个人手机访问企业邮箱，但仅对企业邮箱App内的数据加密并远程擦除，不影响个人照片等隐私内容59。

⏳ 四、技术演进：从MDM到EMM
移动管理技术经历了三个阶段：

设备驱动阶段（2007-2012）：MDM主导，功能限于设备注册、密码策略、远程擦除210。

应用管理阶段（2011-2013）：MAM兴起，引入沙箱/容器隔离企业应用数据，适应BYOD需求25。

内容与身份融合阶段（2013至今）：

EMM整合MCM/MIM，实现基于角色、位置、设备状态的动态策略（如“出差时禁止访问财务系统”）10；

向UEM（统一端点管理）演进，覆盖PC、IoT等更多终端35。

🏢 五、企业应用价值
安全提升：防止数据泄露（如阻断企业文件保存至个人云盘）、抵御越狱/root设备风险16。

效率优化：

自动分发应用（如销售团队统一安装CRM工具）；

远程故障排查，减少现场支持成本9。

合规支持：满足GDPR等法规要求，审计日志记录敏感操作68。

💎 总结
MDM是移动管理的起点，聚焦设备控制；EMM是更成熟的解决方案，通过应用/数据/身份的精细管理，在安全与员工体验间取得平衡。随着远程办公普及，EMM已成为企业移动化转型的核心基础设施，并持续向跨终端、智能化的UEM方向演进358。

entry.title: Cleaning Up the C Drive
entry.content:
1. Use the Disk Cleanup tool

Windows 10 ships with a Disk Cleanup tool that you can use to delete temporary files, system files and other unnecessary files.

  1. Open Disk Cleanup:
    • Click the Start menu, type “Disk Cleanup”, and pick “Disk Cleanup” from the search results.
  • Choose the drive to clean:
    • In the window that pops up, select the C drive (usually the system drive), then click “OK”.
  • Choose the file types to delete:
    • In the Disk Cleanup window, the system lists the file types you can delete (temporary files, system cache, Recycle Bin and so on). You can pick the file types you want to clean up.
      Click the “Clean up system files” button to allow cleaning up more system files (such as Windows Update files).
  • Confirm the deletion:
    • After you click “OK”, the system starts cleaning those files, and once it finishes, space on the C drive is freed up.

2. Delete temporary files

Windows 10 lets you delete temporary files directly — they can pile up and take a lot of space.

  1. Open the “Settings” app, then choose System > Storage.
  • Under “Local Disk (C:)”, click Temporary files.
  • Choose the file types to delete, such as cache and downloaded files.
  • Click the “Delete files” button.

3. Uninstall software you don’t need
Sometimes programs you rarely use take up a lot of disk space.

  1. Open the “Settings” app, then choose Apps > Apps & features.
  • Find the programs you don’t use often, click one, then choose Uninstall.

4. Clear browser cache

Browser caches take up a fair amount of space too, and clearing them regularly helps free up disk space.

  • Google Chrome: go to Settings > Advanced > Privacy and security > Clear browsing data.
  • Microsoft Edge: Settings > Privacy, search, and services > Clear browsing data.

5. Turn off hibernation
If you don’t need hibernation, you can turn it off, because the hibernation file (hiberfil.sys) can sometimes take up a lot of space.

  1. Open Command Prompt (as administrator) and enter the following command:

powercfg -h off

  • Press Enter, which disables hibernation and deletes the hiberfil.sys file.

6. Move files to another drive

If the C drive is still tight on space, you can move large files (videos, images and documents, for example) to another disk partition or an external hard drive.

7. Use third-party tools

Some third-party tools can also help you clean up the C drive and optimize disk space, for example:

  • CCleaner: cleans up system junk files and the registry.
  • WinDirStat: analyzes disk space usage and finds large files.

8. Delete system restore points

If you have System Restore enabled, you may have many restore points eating up disk space.

  1. Right-click This PC and choose Properties.
  • Click System Protection, select the C drive, then click Configure.
  • In the window that pops up, click “Delete” to remove the old restore points.

9. Clean up Windows update files

Windows updates can leave behind unnecessary installation files.

In the Disk Cleanup tool, click “Clean up system files”, select Windows Update Cleanup, then clean up the outdated update files.

With the steps above, you can free up space on the C drive and keep your Windows 10 system running more smoothly.

entry.title: 清理c盘
entry.content:
1. 使用磁盘清理工具

Windows 10自带了一个磁盘清理工具，可以用来删除临时文件、系统文件和其他不必要的文件。

  1. 打开磁盘清理工具：
    • 点击开始菜单，输入“磁盘清理”，并选择搜索结果中的“磁盘清理”。
  • 选择要清理的驱动器：
    • 在弹出的窗口中，选择C盘（通常为系统盘），然后点击“确定”。
  • 选择要删除的文件类型：
    • 在磁盘清理窗口中，系统会列出可以删除的文件类型（如临时文件、系统缓存、回收站等）。你可以选择你想清理的文件类型。
      点击“清理系统文件”按钮，允许清理更多系统文件（如Windows更新文件）。
  • 确认删除：
    • 点击“确定”后，系统将开始清理这些文件，清理完成后C盘的空间将得到释放。

2. 删除临时文件

Windows 10允许你直接删除临时文件，这些文件可能积累过多，占用大量空间。

  1. 打开“设置”应用，选择系统 > 存储。
  • 在“本地磁盘 (C:)”下，点击临时文件。
  • 选择要删除的文件类型，例如缓存、下载的文件等。
  • 点击“删除文件”按钮。

3. 卸载不需要的软件
有时一些不常用的程序占据了大量的磁盘空间。

  1. 打开“设置”应用，选择应用 > 应用和功能。
  • 查找不常用的程序，点击它，然后选择卸载。

4. 清理浏览器缓存

浏览器缓存也会占用不少空间，定期清理这些缓存有助于释放磁盘空间。

  • Google Chrome：进入设置 > 高级 > 隐私与安全 > 清除浏览数据。
  • Microsoft Edge：设置 > 隐私、搜索和服务 > 清除浏览数据。

5. 关闭休眠功能
如果你不需要休眠功能，可以关闭它，因为休眠文件（hiberfil.sys）占用的空间有时会很大。

  1. 打开命令提示符（管理员），输入以下命令：

powercfg -h off

  • 按回车键，这将禁用休眠功能并删除hiberfil.sys文件。

6. 移动文件到其他驱动器

如果C盘空间仍然紧张，你可以将大文件（如视频、图片和文档）移动到其他磁盘分区或外部硬盘。

7. 使用第三方工具

一些第三方工具也可以帮助你清理C盘并优化磁盘空间，例如：

  • CCleaner：清理系统垃圾文件和注册表。
  • WinDirStat：分析磁盘空间占用情况，找出大文件。

8. 删除系统还原点

如果你启用了系统还原，可能会存有很多还原点占用磁盘空间。

  1. 右键点击此电脑，选择属性。
  • 点击系统保护，选择C盘，然后点击配置。
  • 在弹出的窗口中，点击“删除”来删除旧的还原点。

9. 清理Windows更新文件

Windows更新可能会留下不必要的安装文件。

在磁盘清理工具中，点击“清理系统文件”，选择Windows更新清理，然后清理过时的更新文件。

通过以上步骤，你可以释放C盘的空间，使你的Windows 10系统运行得更加顺畅。
